answer: Attach a trust edge, then let it decay 10 percent per idle epoch. Recompute the score each close, re-queue contested claims for a second panel, and vest rewards over 100 epochs. A farm pays full price for edges that rot while it waits. Nice spiral of cost for anyone who buys identities in bulk. The kernel of the score stays the same: work now, pay later. Every ridge of fake vouches erodes on its own.
